name: mac-shell-mcp
description: Run a small set of read-only shell commands, confined to directories you choose.
long_description: Exposes a deliberately small set of commands (ls, pwd, echo, cat, head, tail, wc, grep) confined to directories you nominate. No shell is ever invoked, the child environment is constructed rather than inherited, and no tool can change the policy at runtime. find, git, rm and interpreters are absent by default.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Run a permitted command confined to the configured roots.

tools.name: execute_external_command
tools.description: Run a permitted command outside the roots. Requires an interactive client.

tools.name: execute_pipeline
tools.description: Compose read-only commands, wiring stdout to stdin in process.

tools.name: suggest_policy_config
tools.description: Summarize recorded usage into configuration a human may apply.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed directories
allowed_roots.description: Directories the agent may work in. Everything inside one is freely readable, so choose project directories rather than your home folder.

allowed_commands.title: Allowed commands
allowed_commands.description: Comma-separated. Defaults to a read-only set that cannot write, execute, or read configuration.

audit_log_dir.title: Audit log directory
audit_log_dir.description: Where the record of every command is written. Protected from modification by the server itself.
